description: Turn your company's filing-approval policy on or off. On: no case of yours is filed until you approve its current draft with approve_filing. Off: cases that waited only for your approval go back through eligibility now. (capability: company.settings_own)

company.description: The company to act for, by its domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

name: set_approval_required
